data.title: 佩丽卡 · 把明晨值班记进本子
data.description: 临睡前，佩丽卡在舱室小桌边停笔想了片刻，才把换班时间补进页角。白色薄纱睡袍的宽袖垂在桌边，束带系好，里面的白绸睡裙平整而不透。台灯照着刚写下的那行字，窗外只剩舰体的航行灯。
data.action: 坐在桌边，把明晨换班时间补进笔记本
data.lighting: 桌灯的暖光照亮笔记与白色袖面，舷窗外只见远处航行灯
data.camera: 平视侧面中景，画面带到书桌和腰间系带
data.promptProse: Perlica pauses over her cabin notebook before penciling the morning watch time beside the margin. The wide sleeves of her white gauze robe fall toward the side of the desk, with the waist tie secured over a fully opaque white silk slip. An amber desk lamp lights the page while the ship lights drift past the porthole.
data.animaCaption: She adds the time at the margin, the tied robe falling in loose folds over her opaque white slip.
